A LEARNING COMMUNITY WITH PURPOSE

Knowledge that inspires.
Character that lasts.

Belhaven Montessori School is a child-centred learning community offering preschool, primary and junior high education in Tamale.

Located in Gurugu/Jisonayilli, our school brings academic learning and character development together. We nurture the confidence, independence and curiosity that help children find their own path.

Explore our programmes →

Our Approach

Guided by Montessori principles, we encourage independence, creativity and critical thinking through hands-on experiences. Children are supported to explore, ask questions and grow at their own pace.

From early discoveries to bigger ambitions, we help learners grow intellectually, socially and morally — with a sense of belonging along the way.

A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Before you visit.

Where is Belhaven Montessori School?+

We are in the Gurugu/Jisonayilli area of Tamale, Ghana. Call 024 491 9825 for exact directions and to arrange a visit.

How do I find out about fees and admission?+

Contact the school directly for current fees, available places and the documents required for your child’s programme. Use the enquiry form above or call our team.

What does Montessori-inspired learning mean?+

Our approach encourages children to explore, learn through hands-on experiences and develop independence. Speak with our team during a visit to learn how this works at each stage.

How can parents check academic progress?+

Existing parents and guardians can use the school’s guardian portal to access academic records, attendance and school fee information. Contact the school if you need help with your login.
